scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.dev:web: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; PORT=5173 pnpm --filter @workspace/greenways run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:render: pnpm run typecheck && PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/greenways run build && mkdir -p artifacts/api-server/public && cp -r artifacts/greenways/dist/public/. artifacts/api-server/public/ && NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
